title: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine

info.about: Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine is a 1999 action-adventure video game developed and published by LucasArts. The first 3D installment in the series, its gameplay focuses on solving puzzles, fighting enemies, and completing various platforming sections.
info.trivia: Factor 5 and LucasArts spent 19 months on the port, adding real-time lighting, lock-on targeting and new music by Chris Hülsbeck.
info.why: The N64 version was sold only in North America through the LucasArts Company Store, with most stock going to Blockbuster as rentals.
